analysis: Units are base-side text of a Swift test-only file (provider-swift/Tests/ClusterInstalledSessionChecks/InstalledSessionCheck.swift). The PR change visible in the patch excerpt replaces a PID-derived fixed relay port (47000+pid%1000) with an OS-assigned ephemeral loopback port, avoiding the cluster ports 47421-47423, and adjusts the relay to read relay.port. This is test-harness only: it binds 127.0.0.1 and is not shipped in production provider code. It does not touch the coordinator-provider WebSocket, attestation, App Attest authorization, key custody or prefix-cache storage code paths. The reviewed base text covers tests asserting that the prefix-SSD key (relating to T-041's at-rest cache) never reaches a rank's environment or argv and travels only on the input line bound to epoch and rank. The change does not weaken those assertions and may only make the tests less flaky. The patch excerpt is truncated (ephemeralLoopbackPort is cut off), so I could not inspect the helper's full implementation. It is a test helper that may open a socket; no production exposure is evident. No new attack surface, regression or threat-model invalidation was identified. I did not verify that the head-side test bodies (lines 828, 842-843 shifts) are unchanged beyond line renumbering.
